title: Secure the island office game assets

assets.name: Universal Base Characters
assets.changes: Female character palette tinted deep teal and warm gold for the player; male character palette tinted forest green and coral for the office manager. The source models and textures are otherwise retained.
assets.reason: Shared humanoid rig and compatible appearance for a distinct player and non-player guide.

assets.name: Universal Animation Library
assets.changes: Loaded lazily and used for in-place walk, idle, conversational and interaction clips.
assets.reason: Animation bones match the selected character rigs; provides real articulated movement.

assets.name: Stylized Nature MegaKit
assets.changes: Selected a small shared-palette subset and arranged it into the island garden; source meshes and textures are retained.
assets.reason: Adds a consistent stylized botanical language without mixing unrelated environment packs.
